videos.description:
What happens to economic opportunity when AI changes the jobs people rely on? Reid Hoffman and Aria Finger explore why entrepreneurial skills will matter in every career and how AI can help more people start businesses. Reid traces his focus on expanding access to good jobs from founding LinkedIn to working with Opportunity@Work, including opportunities for workers without college degrees. They also discuss his AI-made album celebrating America’s 250th anniversary and how creative experiments can deepen human connection. His framework for guiding AI decisions puts humanity first, then society, then industry.
